# Transition report: relation kinds, statuses and the RxClass warrant (add-scoped-reasoning 1.1 and 1.2)

2026-11-01. Every value the change of tasks 1.1 and 1.2 changes in the reading of the frozen NSCLC records,
old and new, with its reason. Outputs change by design (design.md Decisions 1, 2, 7 and 8; task 1.2).

## Method

- Records: the frozen folder of 487 interventional Phase 3 NSCLC trials (`/tmp/nsclc3`, read-only), copied
  whole to a private folder first; nothing was written to the original. The copy's `classes.json` was read as
  cached: no name was looked up, and no request reached RxNav or the registry.
- Before: the code at commit `25a9039`; after: this change. Each run read the population once
  (`reading.read_population` over `studies.json` with the cached RxClass answers) and laid it out
  (`design.sheets`); the script kept every trial's coordinates at each level, its stratum, observations,
  review flags and drugs, the near-miss pairs, and the Profile, Mechanism Signals, Occupancy, Expectations,
  Results, Near Misses, Review Queue, Relations, Classes, Trials and Coordinates sheets. Warrant columns are
  left out of every comparison: every warrant that digests `coherence.resolve` (the Trials, Criteria,
  Residual, Audit, Coordinates, Outcomes and Results sheets' trials rule, the near-miss rule) changed with its
  code, as it must. After review, every design.xlsx warrant but the Rules sheet's changed again (see "After
  review" at the end); no value did.
- Below, "known" is the known domain (stated evidence and strict relations), "interpolated" the default
  relations added, and each proposal is applied alone to the interpolated domain.

## Summary

- **Relations.** Each relation now has a kind apart from its approval and basis. The four approved on
  2026-10-31 are `default` (approval unchanged: `approved`); the three proposed are `proposal` (approval
  `proposed`); none is `strict` (Decision 8, Codex's counterexamples).
- **Setting domains.** 233 trials' reported setting changed from the approved-relation domain to the known
  domain, which is all nine values for every one of the 487 trials (no relation is strict, and no atom states
  the setting). The old domain is now, value for value, the interpolated domain (checked on every trial and
  every coordinate). No other coordinate changed.
- **Proposals.** 53 trials have a proposal narrowing their setting. Each is now shown alone, from the
  interpolated domain; the values differ from the old cumulative reading only for the 6 trials where a
  resection and resectable disease are both required (old: `perioperative`; new: `adjuvant | perioperative`
  and `neoadjuvant | perioperative`, each on its own).
- **Strata.** 82 trials had a known setting (one value) and now stand in `setting unresolved`, with every
  other trial: the strata read the known setting only. Profile rows 1,101 → 884 and Mechanism Signals rows
  3,930 → 3,600; every row over all trials is unchanged.
- **Occupancy.** All 198 cells changed: the 11 occupied cells are now `unknown`, no trial occupies a cell, and
  each trial of a class (or with an unclassed drug) is counted as one that could fall in each cell.
- **Near-miss pairs.** None before, none after. The representation is still known-or-interpolated for the same
  27 trials, now all interpolated; the Near Misses header says so, and a `Rests On` column labels each pair.
- **Expectation observations.** The frozen expectation's observations did not change: status, reason, cited
  criteria, qualifiers and deviation are identical for all 487 trials. Their cell, rarity source, share, count
  and bits did change for every row, because the cell is the known setting stratum.
- **Review flags.** None changed (428 rows before and after, identical to `25a9039`'s Review Queue warrant
  aside): the queue raises a conflict of the known or the interpolated level (after review), and neither the
  stated evidence nor the defaults emptied a coordinate on these records.
- **Results grouping.** The same 22,503 measurements; 29 trials with posted results moved from their known
  setting group to `setting unresolved`.
- **RxClass warrant (1.2).** The Classes sheet keeps its 1,433 rows and values and gains the requests and the
  RxNav release of each answer. Every answer in this folder was cached before answers carried a warrant, so
  every row says `(not_recorded)` with no requests; nothing was looked up and no release was invented. A
  lookup from now on asks `version.json` once per batch and keeps each request's URL, parameters and retrieval
  time.
- **Columns.** The Trials, Coordinates, Relations, Near Misses and Classes sheets' headers changed as listed
  below; the resolve JSON's `coordinates` object is now `known`, `interpolated` and `proposed` (each with its
  domain, state, status and removals), its near misses carry `rests_on`, and each experimental drug carries
  `rxclass`, each name's warrant. landscape.json's coordinates are `<name>`, `<name>_interpolated` and
  `<name>_proposed`.

## Invariants checked on all 487 trials

- The new interpolated domain equals the old reported (approved-relation) domain for every trial and every
  coordinate: yes (487 trials x 11 coordinates).
- Every coordinate other than the setting has the same known domain as before: yes.
- The known setting is unnarrowed (all nine values) for 487 of 487 trials: no relation is strict, and no atom
  states the setting itself.

## Setting domains

233 trials' reported setting domain changed: it was the domain under the four approved relations, and is now
the known domain (stated evidence and strict relations; none is strict), which for the setting is every value.
The narrowing moved, unchanged, to the interpolated domain (default relations added). Reason: Decision 8, the
four approved relations are defaults, not strict.

Counts by old setting domain (old → known: all nine values; interpolated: the old domain):

| Old reported setting domain (now the interpolated domain) | Trials |
|---|---|
| advanced_first_line \| advanced_previously_treated \| maintenance \| local_consolidative_therapy | 119 |
| advanced_first_line | 82 |
| advanced_previously_treated \| maintenance | 32 |

## Proposals: cumulative before, each alone now

53 trials have a proposal that narrows their setting. Before, the three proposed relations were applied
together to the approved domain; now each proposal is applied alone to the interpolated domain (the same set
of values), never cumulatively. The values differ only where two or more proposals fire: 6 trials.

## Review flags

0 trials' review flags changed. Review Queue rows: 428 before, 428 after, value for value (warrants aside).
The queue reads each coordinate at its interpolated level (`reading.review_coordinates`, after review), which
holds every conflict of the known level and every one the defaults make; on these records neither occurs, so
no coordinate_conflict flag is raised before or after. (The commit under review read the known level alone,
which would have dropped a conflict a default makes; none occurs here, so its queue was the same.)

## After review (2026-11-01)

The review of the first commit asked for the warrants, landscape.json's near-miss rows and its versions to say
what changed, for the review queue to keep the conflicts the defaults make, and for tests of the new shapes. Run
on the same private copy of the frozen records (the original folder untouched), three code trees side by side:
`25a9039`, the commit under review (`ca046a0`) and this change.

- **Values.** Every value of every design.xlsx sheet (warrant columns aside) is the same as under `ca046a0`, so
  every value listed above stands: Trials 487, Criteria 10,187, Residual 1,630, Audit 350, Coordinates 1,195,
  Outcomes 4,878, Results 22,503, Expectations 487, Review Queue 428, Near Misses 0, Drug Axes 4,767, Rules 29,
  Relations 7, Classes 1,433, Profile 884, Mechanism Signals 3,600 and Occupancy 198 rows, each the same.
- **Review flags.** The 428 flags are those of `25a9039` and of `ca046a0`, value for value: the queue now
  reads the interpolated level, which no default empties here.
- **Warrants.** Every warrant of every sheet changed except the Rules sheet's (literal text), by design: the
  design version is now `design-2` (the strata, cells, occupancy and results read the known setting only);
  every rule that reads a coordinate (the trials rule of the Trials, Criteria, Residual, Audit, Coordinates,
  Outcomes and Results sheets; the profile, mechanism, expectation, occupancy, review and near-miss rules)
  digests the relations table, each relation's kind among its fields, and `coherence.resolve`,
  `coherence.accepted_value` and `design._stratum` beside its own code, so a relation made strict changes them;
  each Relations row's warrant digests that relation; each Classes row's covers its requests and release; the
  review rule digests `reading.review_flags` and `reading.review_coordinates`. Changed: Trials 487, Criteria
  10,187, Residual 1,630, Audit 350, Coordinates 1,195, Outcomes 4,878, Results 22,503, Expectations 487,
  Review Queue 428, Drug Axes 4,767 (the design version alone), Relations 7, Classes 1,433, Profile 884,
  Mechanism Signals 3,600, Occupancy 198.
- **landscape.json.** `schema_version` is `2` (the coordinates' three statuses replace
  `<name>_with_proposed_relations`, and the statuses' meanings changed with them, so a record of schema 1 is
  refused as `unknown_schema_version` rather than read as this one); `manifest.rule_versions` gains
  `relation_kinds` (each relation's kind beside `relations`, its approval) and its `design` is `design-2`; each
  row of `cohort.near_misses` and `cohort.aligned_near_misses` gains `rests_on`, the weakest status its two
  settings rest on, and the field definitions say so (they had said "known"). On these records there is no
  pair, as written or aligned, before or after, so no row changes.
